messages:
marie: Quick heads-up — planning a prod deploy in ~45m (16:00 UTC). No DB schema changes. Posting a short rollback/readiness runbook and asking for quick acks. Runbook: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/deploy-llm-routing

marie: Preflight (condensed):
```
- owner: marie
- smoke lead: ashok
- canary plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% (5m hold at each)
- fallback model: gptx-2q -> gptx-2 (binary compatible)
- feature toggle: feature.toggle.llm_new_routing
- rollback commands: see ops snippet below
- monitoring: latency >300ms alert, error rate >1% alert, eval prompt set check
```

devin: who is owning infra page / scaling during the push?

marie: lena will own infra scaling + rollback pager, ashok owns smoke checks and functional validation. devin you ok to be on async standby for 30m after the final ramp?

devin: yes, I can be reachable.

ashok: I'll run the smoke steps. Planned smoke checklist: call /v1/generate with a few sample prompts, run an embedding similarity check against a small corpus, validate a cached prefix works (no KV corruption), and synthetic load at 20 qps for 2m. Posting commands now.

ashok: ```bash
# basic generation smoke
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"gptx-2q","prompt":"smoke test"}' | jq .
# expect 200 and non-empty choices
# embedding sample
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"test","model":"embed-lite"}' | jq .
```

lena: toggle name? And confirm no rollout DB migrations?

marie: toggle = feature.toggle.llm_new_routing (default OFF). No migrations in this release — purely routing & model variant artifact. If any part fails, we'll flip the toggle off and rollback model tag.

ops-runner: adding rollback snippets for quick copy/paste:
```bash
# toggle off (fast)
redwood feature toggle set --name feature.toggle.llm_new_routing --env prod --value false
# full rollback to previous stable tag (if toggle flip doesn't help)
redwood deploy rollback --env prod --to-tag stable-2024-10-20T12:00Z --force
```

ops-runner: note: rollback WILL clear local per-node kv caches; plan for a 60s tail of higher latency.

oncall-bot: Reminder: deploy window at 16:00 UTC. Pager schedule for this window: lena -> ashok -> devin. Please acknowledge.

sophia: I'll monitor trace and logs (console -> traces -> llm-routing) and watch the eval prompt set for regressions. If I see >1% regen errors or lat spikes, I'll call stop.

ashok: I'll post smoke results 10m before canary flip. Quick metric to watch: p95 latency for /v1/generate and error count per minute.

marie: If you can be available for rollback activities for 30m after the final ramp, react with :white_check_mark:. If you cannot, say so now.

lena: :white_check_mark:
ashok: :white_check_mark:
devin: :white_check_mark:
sophia: :thumbsup:

marie: thanks — will start the run in ~40m, will post a final go/no-go 5m before. If anyone spots an immediate blocker speak up now.

devin: one last question — any special tracing flags to enable?

ashok: enabling extra debug traces for the canary only: set REDWOOD_TRACE_SAMPLING=0.5 for the canary pool. I'll handle that before flip.

marie: perfect. closing the loop here — will ping again at t-5.
